text:
Sasha: Burrito diplomacy take 2: someone left an unmarked breakfast burrito. Is the correct protocol A) eat it, B) coronate it as communal, C) sacrifice to the toaster oven, D) start a raffle? :joy:
Miguel: D is an elegant solution. Also document the raffle with a sticky note.
Priya: I'm going with A if it smells like optimism. Otherwise DM first.
OpsBot: Heads up: kitchen audit tomorrow at 10am. Any unclaimed perishables will be tagged and added to the communal shelf. :label:
Jen: Suggestion: add a tiny sticky that says "Contains joy" and initial it. Social pressure helps.
Theo: The burrito raffle concept is now the official team-building exercise. I call dibs on ticket #7.
Anya: Quick straw poll: react with :one: = Raffle, :two: = Label or lose, :three: = 48h rule, :four: = Sacrifice to toaster oven
Sasha: :two:
Miguel: :one: (but only if proceeds go to office snacks)
Priya: :three: for perishables, :two: for anything suspicious-looking
Jen: :two: and we should have a standardized label format: name, date, reheating method. Minimalist.
Theo: +1 for reheating method. I once revived a burrito with an air fryer and it felt like space travel.
Sasha: Note for the label: cilantro Y/N and heat preference (crispy/soft).
OpsBot: Policy update proposal: "All items must be labeled with owner, date, and cilantro preference. Unlabeled items older than 48h become raffle entries." Please file feedback.
Anya: I volunteer to run the inaugural burrito raffle. Prize: one bag of hot chips.
LunchBot: Poll created by Anya: "What should happen to unlabeled fridge items?" 1: Raffle, 2: Label or lose, 3: 48h rule, 4: Toaster oven sacrifice. Poll ends in 24h.
Priya: Also, can we agree foil = no-go for toaster oven. Let's save the transformers for Halloween.
Miguel: Agreed. And whoever invented the burrito vault gets my eternal gratitude and one coffee.
Jen: I'm drafting a tiny label template and will post it in #design later. It will be very chic. :sparkles:
Sasha: Thanks team. If you find a ticket in your desk with #7, that's Theo. :taco:
